name: Synapse Layer
description: Persistent memory infrastructure for AI agents — encrypted, governed, and cross-agent. The OAuth for AI Memory.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Deterministically retrieves past context and decisions. Supports routing modes (auto/temporal/semantic/priority/hybrid).

tools.name: save_to_synapse
tools.description: Persists content with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest, PII redaction, and Trust Quotient scoring.

tools.name: process_text
tools.description: Self-extracting memory engine. Scans free-form text for milestones, decisions, alerts.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Cross-agent memory search with full-text and semantic matching.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Verify system availability. Public method — no auth required at the tool level.

tools.name: initialize_context
tools.description: Loads persistent memory context and user profile at conversation start.

tools.name: save_memory
tools.description: Save a memory with AES-256-GCM encryption. Alias for save_to_synapse with tag support.

tools.name: store_memory
tools.description: Store context, preferences, or facts with AES-256-GCM encryption.

tools.name: recall_memory
tools.description: Retrieves long-term memory. Alias for recall with routing modes and scope filtering.

tools.name: list_memories
tools.description: List memory metadata without exposing plaintext content.

tools.name: memory_feedback
tools.description: Record feedback on a recalled memory to improve future recall quality.

tools.name: neural_handover
tools.description: Secure Agent Handover V2 — Consume a one-time encrypted handover token from another agent context.

tools.name: slo_report
tools.description: Admin-only SLO observability report with percentile latencies and per-tool breakdown.
